name: suit
brief: Crew hardsuit, third person: a human in practical worn-in EVA work gear, 1.78-1.85 m, helmet with a visor that shows where it looks, soft-joint suit segments, mag boots, a backpack housing the EVA thrusters and the grapple reel. Rigid parts pivoted at their joints like the Gunner, standing in a low-ready carry with a closed fist round a pistol grip in each hand. paint_secondary is the per-player identity colour on the shoulders, helmet crest and backpack. Bone-white shell, charcoal soft suit, quiet lime status lights, warm white visor rim and headlamp.
